violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ONSITE DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM SHOULD BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' PIC WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC COPIES OF EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY. PLEASE ENSURE ALL STAFF SIGN A COPY BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK NEXT TO ICE MACHINE MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 63F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE ENSURE THE HANDWASHING SINK CAN MEET 100F BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. CHICAGO'S PIZZA WITH A TWIST (Inspection Date: 12/01/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: OBSERVED ACCUMULATION OF DEBRIS ALONG THE INTERIOR OF THE ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PLEASE ENSURE THE ICE MACHINE IS CLEANED AND SANITIZED PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED A CAN OF RAID STORED ON THE GREASE TRAP.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC REMOVED THE PEST CONTROL DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL MAY NOT BE USED IN THE ESTABLISHMENT.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED FROZEN CHICKEN AND SAUSAGE THAWING ON COUNTER-TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER THAWING METHODS WITH PIC.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED VARIOUS BOTTLES OF SAUCES WITHOUT A LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL FOOD ITEMS NOT IN ORIGINAL CONTAINER SHOULD BE LABELED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS STORED ON THE FLOOR OF THE WALK-IN COOLER AND THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOOD ITEMS ARE ELEVATED AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF HTE GROUND TO ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING AND TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION .

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the QUATERNARY AMMONIA chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED MISSING CEILING TILES NEAR PRODUCE WALK-IN COOLER AND BATHROOMS.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC UNDERSTANDS CEILING TILES SHOULD BE REPLACED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: OBSERVED ACCUMULATION OF DEBRIS ALONG INTERIOR WALL OF ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PIC UNDERSTANDS ICE MACHINE SHOULD BE CLEANED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: PEELED GARLIC manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of DICED PEPPERS AND DICED TOMATOES.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC REMOVED FOODS FROM THESE CONTAINERS DURING INSPECTION AND PUT FOODS IN NSF-APPROVED/DURABLE CONTAINERS. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE CONTAINERS SHOULD NOT BE REUSED BECAUSE THEY ARE NOT MADE TO BE WASHED/RINSED/SANITIZED REPEATEDLY.
